text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 黑色矩形太阳镜。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Edit this isolated accessory photo. Remove the entire silver chain from the sunglasses. Keep only one pair of black rectangular sunglasses. Plain white background. Do not add anything. Preserve object design, color and material.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
